instruction.text: Order the steps of how an earthquake happens.

atoms.text: Two tectonic plates move alongside or into one another.
Friction or pressure is built up between the plates.
The energy eventually becomes too much and is released.
This energy travels to the Earth’s surface and causes the ground to shake.

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: What is the focus of an earthquake?

b.sound: the place inside the Earth’s crust where an earthquake starts.
The place on the Earth’s surface that suffers the most damage.
smaller earthquakes that occur after the mainshock in the same area
smaller earthquakes that occur before the mainshock

atoms.a: Earthquakes are measured using the Scoville scale.
The 2011 earthquake in Japan measured 9 on the Richter scale.
What are some of the impacts of earthquakes?
Which natural disasters can earthquakes trigger?
